from cyhole.jupiter import Jupiter
from cyhole.jupiter.schema import GetSwapOrderParams, PostSwapExecuteBody

# Solana token addresses
SOL_MINT = "So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112"
USDC_MINT = "EPjFWaJgt2qwNsnGkPfsnKgCjagYjVMZnqLBbgJMqS1"

# Initialize Jupiter client
jupiter = Jupiter()

# Create swap quote parameters (1 SOL)
quote_params = GetSwapOrderParams(
    input_mint=SOL_MINT,
    output_mint=USDC_MINT,
    amount=1_000_000_000,  # 1 SOL in lamports
)

# Get swap quote
quote_response = jupiter.client.get_swap_order(quote_params)
print("Swap Quote:")
print(f"  Input: {quote_response.in_amount}")
print(f"  Output: {quote_response.out_amount}")
print(f"  Price Impact: {quote_response.price_impact_pct}%")

# Execute the swap using the quote
execute_body = PostSwapExecuteBody(
    order_address=quote_response.order_address,
)

# Submit swap execution
execute_response = jupiter.client.post_swap_execute(execute_body)
print("\nSwap Execution:")
print(f"  Transaction: {execute_response.tx_id}")
print(f"  Status: {execute_response.status}")
